**CHANGE YOUR LIFE\! CHANGE YOUR WORLD\!**

**InterPlay Life Practice Program DC**

*Unlock the Wisdom of Your Body*

The InterPlay Life Practice Program is an active, creative way to **change your life and change your world.** It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the system of InterPlay—ideas and practices that can move you from where you are to where you would like to be. ** T**hrough movement, story, sound, and stillness, discover creative ways to change what you want to change in your life.

Another feature of the LifePractice Program is a steadfast community. You may use this supportive, affirming community to help you **shape your life in ways that are best for you.** You will get individual attention from program leaders who will help you identify your personal desires and intentions.

This year’s program is offered over five months. The bulk of instruction occurs during two in-person retreats, which bookend bi-weekly online sessions.

**If you want to register, indicate your interest by completing the [I’m Interested](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScKLZjyZSM5x5vxzhTQj5pAngUbPTtsI0Ll-CT5-8HkcHVWTQ/viewform?usp=header) form while the official registration and payment page is set up.**

***Elements of the Life Practice Program***

• A series of **regular gatherings over 5 months in 2026–27** for play, presentation, discernment, and interaction, where you will have a chance to explore new options in a supportive community. 

• **Three focus sessions** during which you receive personal support from the program leaders to get more of what you want.

• **Reading, writing, and sharing practices** which will help us apply InterPlay insights to our own life, based on the digital texts: *Having it All \- Body, Mind, Heart & Spirit Together Again At Last* and *The Wisdom of the Body*. These reflections can take many different forms: writings, letters, artwork, poetry, photography, video/audio recordings, etc.

• The ***InterPlay 8 Core Elements Self-Study*** and an InterPlay Life Practice Program booklet that will give you a more in-depth understanding of the InterPlay system.

• A ***Body-Spirit Celebration*** during the final weekend to play with the InterPlay forms and share them with each other in a celebratory and honoring way.
